inventory.anchor: MOZ_EACH_BC_FIELD list (the FIELD of InnerSizeSpoofedForRFP; the new FIELD follows it)
inventory.notes: One FIELD, StealthWindowState (uint64_t, top only, CanSet::Unrestricted), the main window's restored state: restored or not, outer size in device pixels, UI density. It is synced to every process on the top BrowsingContext with the same policy as Mozilla's InnerSizeSpoofedForRFP, and moved only by Juggler's notification, handled by a parent-process observer with the declared scale. outerWidth/outerHeight, screenX/Y, mozInnerScreenX/Y and the screenX - clientX of every event are derived from it.

Carries the synced field StealthWindowState across a BrowsingContext replacement, exactly as Mozilla carries its own synced fields there (the line after txn.SetInnerSizeSpoofedForRFP): without it a replaced context would answer the maximized window again. One line, the setter that the FIELD macro of BrowsingContext.h generates.

Mixed file. (1) language-declared and timezone-declared: CreateNativeGlobalForInner takes language and zone from the declared session (GetDeclaredLanguage/GetDeclaredTimezone in StealthSessionDeclaration) instead of Top()->GetLanguageOverride()/GetTimezoneOverride(). (2) window-geometry: GetOuterSize and GetScreenXY answer declared maximized-window or popup geometry. (3) window-geometry: StealthContentOriginShift (new, about 45 lines) and IsInStealthPopup (new), used by mozInnerScreenX/Y here and by Event.cpp. Most of the 66 logic lines are in these functions; they can move wholesale to our own file. Comments are largely in Italian. The 'return {}' after the gate is kept, per its own comment. The shift function calls BrowserChild::GetDimensions in content processes.

inventory.anchor: nsWindow::MakeFullScreen (the branch for an X11 display whose window manager does not support fullscreen, before NS_ERROR_NOT_AVAILABLE)
inventory.notes: Guard in the branch where Mozilla refuses fullscreen for lack of a window manager: StealthMakeFullScreenWithoutWM resizes the X window to the declared screen and answers true, as Windows and the headless widget decide fullscreen themselves. With the engine off, or on a kiosk monitor, it answers false and Mozilla's return runs.
Declares nsWindow::StealthMakeFullScreenWithoutWM (defined in widget/gtk/StealthFullscreenGtk.cpp, a member so it can set the size mode and the client area as OnWindowStateEvent does).
